nodes.name: POST news reaction
nodes.notes: Refreshes the Home news context 30 min after the OpenClaw digest run: GDELT watchlist headlines (Google News RSS fallback when GDELT throttles) plus saved digests, compared with next daily closes. Writes data/analytics/news-reaction/latest.json. Context only: never a trade signal, never touches approvals, the ledger or doctrine.

jarvise.import: n8n import:workflow --input=infra/n8n/workflows/jarvise-news-reaction.json, then publish:workflow --id=jrvsNewsReact0749 and restart n8n
